title: Amelia | Leopard Jumpsuit with V-Neckline and Waist Tie
bodyHtml:
This is the jumpsuit that does it all—from Sydney summer days to elegant evenings. A leopard print in warm blacks and beiges pairs with a flattering V-neckline, delicate shoulder straps, and a clever waist tie that lets you shape the fit exactly how you want it. Soft and fluid, it skims your frame with easy movement, never clinging, while wide-leg trousers keep you comfortable all day long.

Why you'll love it

  • V-neckline with thin straps creates a feminine, elongated silhouette
  • Waist tie lets you define or soften the look—your call, every time
  • Wide-leg cut that lengthens without ever feeling tight or restrictive
  • Leopard print in neutrals that works effortlessly from day to night
  • Soft, breathable fabric moves with you—designed for all-day ease
  • Works perfectly for warm days, resort wear, casual outings or occasions
  • A rare find: this kind of versatile animal-print jumpsuit is genuinely hard to track down

Over 50,000 women have already chosen us, with an average rating of 4.8 out of 5. Your happiness and your trust mean everything to us.
